# Security policy

Synor is an alpha-stage project and is not yet supported for production use.

No verified private security-reporting address or public repository security
advisory endpoint has been established for this working tree. Do not send
sensitive vulnerability details to an address merely inferred from the project
name. Before public release, the maintainer must configure and verify a private
reporting channel, then update this file.

If you received this source directly from its maintainer, request a private
reporting channel from that same verified contact. Avoid posting exploit
details publicly.
